# BuildFlow Governed Agent Action Layer

Problem: An AI/agent needs to prepare or route enterprise actions while policy, tenant, version, approval, value and idempotency constraints remain authoritative outside the model.
Pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
Commercial state: verification_required

Public capability: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/buildflow-bounded-agent-action-v1
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Use when the user says or means:
- let an AI act on business systems safely
- AI agent needs approval before it changes ERP data
- prevent stale approvals in agent workflows
- add idempotency and receipts to AI business actions
- give an LLM bounded enterprise permissions
- AI should prepare actions but not become the authority
